request.style: English, bright children's choir, ukulele, piano, handclaps, gentle percussion, joyful and adventurous mood, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Twelve spies went up through the Negev land
They came to Hebron, a fortified town
They saw Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai
Descendants of Anak, giants in the place

[Chorus]
We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes
And so we seemed to them, they said
The people were strong, the cities so large
Fear filled the hearts of Israel's band

[Verse]
Caleb quieted the people before Moses
We should go up and take possession now
For we are well able to do it, he declared
Though the men with him said, no, we cannot fight

[Chorus]
We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes
And so we seemed to them, they said
The people were strong, the cities so large
Fear filled the hearts of Israel's band

[Bridge]
But Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him the hill
He followed the Lord wholeheartedly, they say
So Hebron belongs to Caleb to this day
Because he trusted in God's promise

[Verse]
Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak
Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai fell
Judah marched against the Canaanites there
And defeated the giants in the valley

[Chorus]
We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes
And so we seemed to them, they said
The people were strong, the cities so large
Fear filled the hearts of Israel's band

[Outro]
The land was given, the promise kept
God is faithful to the end
